title: An Introduction to the Blog
text:
This is a First!
I suppose I will start with the intended purpose of this blog.
I hope to showcase some of my prior work as well as give updates regarding any topics I may be learning about at the moment. This will ultimately become a space to catalog my passion projects. The scope of this is to be determined, but it will definitely include some work involving statistical modeling, geospatial data visualization, as well as some book reviews.
Stay tuned.
